tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background and the sticky nav base. Everything sits on this near-black navy.

tokens.name: bg-mid
tokens.usage: Lower stop of card gradients.

tokens.name: bg-deep
tokens.usage: Footer and roadmap band tint; the darkest ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Upper stop of card gradients and dropdown lists.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The brand accent: primary buttons, eyebrows, links, active states, glows. The only accent hue.

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Text on green fills (buttons, check badges, text selection). 9:1 on green.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warning and error text, remove-hover, 'to do' tags. Never a decorative accent.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg. 15:1.

tokens.name: ink-sub
tokens.usage: Hero subtitle text.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Quotes and list rows inside cards.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Body copy, secondary labels, nav links. 7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary copy such as revealed origin text. 5.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and character counters only. About 3.6:1 on bg, so never for required reading.

tokens.name: footnote
tokens.usage: Footer copyright line. About 2.7:1 on bg: below 4.5:1, kept as in the source; use ink or muted for anything that must be read.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders, 1px dividers, input borders (16% muted).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: FAQ list rules, 2px (28% muted).

tokens.name: fill-subtle
tokens.usage: Input fill and dim number fills (8% muted).

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Hover wash and icon chip fill (10% green).

tokens.name: green-line
tokens.usage: Green borders and underlines at rest (30% green).

tokens.name: green-glow
tokens.usage: Glow colour for shadows and blurred halos (35% green).

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Landing hero headline. Fluid: clamp(44px, 7.4vw, 104px); 33-50px on phones.

styles.name: h2-split
styles.usage: Headings beside a feature card. clamp(26px, 3.2vw, 44px).

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: Headline figure in a feature card.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Name or title inside a feature card.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Step titles, role titles, FAQ questions (600).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Feature paragraph, in muted. Legal pages use 16px / 1.7.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary button label (19px on the XL button, 14.5px in the nav).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section label above headings. Always uppercase, in green, with a 28px fading rule before it.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small uppercase captions in muted (card eyebrows, 'games' strip, footer column titles in green).

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Prices, times and other figures in cards.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat number, with a 9px uppercase label below.

spacing.note: The source uses ad-hoc pixel values. These steps are the values it repeats most, rounded to a 4px base.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label nudges.

tokens.name: space-2

tokens.name: space-3

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gap between role cards, input two-up gap, mono rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card grid gap, section divider margins inside cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Quote card padding.

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Footer grid gap, stacked section parts.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Social row offset.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section padding minimum; the background grid pitch.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chart bars, thin indicators.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, dropdown lists, dashed 'add' buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Quote cards, role cards, icon chips, the social row.

tokens.name: radius-xl

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, nav link and progress bar. The brand's signature shape.

tokens.name: radius-round

tokens.name: shadow-cta-xl

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Feature mock cards.

tokens.name: shadow-card-sm
tokens.usage: Quote cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
